input.free_text_description: This system is a social platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for i abnormala action, i echnicalaspect, i replay. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with stock functionality, so that I can accomplish my stock-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use i abnormala action capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use i echnicalaspect capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
